name: Deluge: Raintime
source:
—there's something wrong with the lake, the lake that was once a sea.

Certain things are better left alone, they don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge, that sleeps under the soil for decades—

Built on an artificial island, the university town of Bremersberg harbors abnormalities that lay hidden in plain sight. Follow William, an unassuming college student, as he grows increasingly obsessed with the island's secrets. Will William get a grip on himself, before his curiosity drives him to unfettered madness?

Deluge: Raintime builds forth on The Raintime. Introducing a mostly new cast of characters, the game reveals secrets that strike at the core of Deluge Chronicles. In addition, the full release of Deluge: Raintime also contains an After Story to Deluge, following the lives of Abe, Rika, Ina and Mei five years after the conclusion of Sermon for the Dead.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4242850/Deluge_Raintime/]Steam[/url]]
